scope.target: Deterministic agent execution packets, leases, evidence binding, report parity, retry, host-command, and discovery freshness enforcement
constraints: Compose with #118/#119, #194, #204, and #249 without transferring domain ownership
Reject incomplete or inapplicable dispatch before invocation
Prevent tracked writers during an active exact-head lease while distinguishing allowed ignored artifacts
Synthetic/mock/unit evidence cannot satisfy actual execution acceptance
non_goals: Automatic commit, push, PR, or provider permission
Private paths, usernames, hostnames, or secrets in fixtures

steps: Inventory current commit, delegation, terminal runner, and role-execution validators
Define and implement execution packet and worktree lease contracts
Implement acceptance ledger/report parity and retry/freshness controls
Add PowerShell and discovery fallback regressions
execution.next_action: Begin after GOV013-001 establishes the shared validation lifecycle owner surface.
